description: A huge brown insect rears up out of tall green grass, seen very close at the party's eye level, its head filling the upper middle of the square. Its body is made of heavy rounded brown plates outlined in black, with a segmented salmon-pink underside running down the centre. Two big glossy black eyes with white glints sit on the head, two thin jointed antennae rise toward the top edge, and crooked brown legs and pincer-like mouthparts curl around the front. The background is a bright cyan daytime sky over a band of dense, speckled green and grey grass. The light is sunny and flat; the mood is an unnerving close-up of something far too large. Frame 1: the head is raised and turned slightly to the viewer's left, mouthparts open. Frame 2: the head dips toward the viewer, the antennae swing and the mouthparts close. Both frames are held equally and briefly, so the loop reads as a steady, twitchy bobbing of the head and chewing of the jaws.
title: Giant insect in tall grass
